solution.approach: Check if sum of digits each raised to power of total digits equals original number.

code.Python3:
import sys
def main():
    s = sys.stdin.read().strip()
    if not s.isdigit(): return
    n = int(s)
    p = len(s)
    print("Yes" if sum(int(d)**p for d in s) == n else "No")
if __name__ == "__main__": main()

editorial.overview: Compute sum of d^p for each digit d where p is number of digits. Output 'Yes' or 'No'.
